name: Fleshbending shares critical strike chance with the party (#2209)
contract: Fleshbending 680684 reads 'Your critical strikes now increase the critical strike chance of all party and raid members by $582766s1% for $582766d'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Fleshbending 582766 (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID, SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT, BasePoints 4 -> +5%, radius index 12, TargetA 1). The aura-42 effect's own BasePoints 49 is dead data: AuraEffect::HandleProcTriggerSpellAuraProc ignores the amount. Spell.dbc gives 680684 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and no party member ever received the buff. Bloodbolt is cast as rank 578305 (the rank a level-80 character owns; 578304 is only granted up to level 52 and gets no server response) and spell_crit_rating 100000 makes the critical strike deterministic instead of hoping for one.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Fleshbending passive is active
No Fleshbending buff on the party member before the cast
DISCRIMINATING: the party member gains Fleshbending 582766
Fleshbending grants the DBC value of +5% critical strike chance
